text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Thirty-nine hundred and twelve is hereby amended to read as
"Section 3. All balances of the several appropriations made by this Act the destination of which has not been
determined by proper authority on December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-two, and all balances of
appropriations remaining free or unexpended on December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and thirty-three, shall
revert to the unappropriated funds in the Insular Treasury, and thereafter shall not be available for expenditure
except upon appropriation by the Legislature."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, September 4, 1933.
